Interface LanguageModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
JlmLanguageModel
public interface LanguageModel
A JLM1 character-level language model held in PSRAM, answering one question at a time, one character at a time.

Take the model from its board once, at startup, with MCU.getLanguageModel(), and begin() it: the build links the JLM1 file named by -Djuno.lm.model into the firmware (such as juno-lm's JUNO.BIN, trained from the Juno facts), so one juno:flash uploads the program and its model together, and the engine copies it into PSRAM with its attention cache. begin(SdCard, String) loads a JLM1 file from an SD card instead, so a model can change without reflashing. Then ask(String, int) a question and call nextChar() until it returns END. Each character is handed over as soon as it is generated, so the same loop can print it to the serial port, write it to an HTTP response or send it over TCP, and nothing is allocated per answer.

A question is printable ASCII, at most MAX_QUESTION characters; longer text is cut. The engine reads it the way the model was trained: in lower case, with ? ! , ; and quotes as spaces and runs of spaces collapsed, so wordings that differ only in case or punctuation are the same question. Asking runs the question through the model, which takes about 30 ms per character on the Nano ESP32, and also picks the answer's first 8 characters: if the model is unsure of any of them, the answer is "I do not know." instead of a guess. Each later nextChar() takes about the same 30 ms.

  • Method Details

    • begin

      ModelStatus begin()
      Loads the JLM1 model the build linked into the firmware, replacing any model loaded before. A program that calls this method must be built with -Djuno.lm.model=<file>, or the build fails. Returns ModelStatus.OK, or why it could not.

    • begin

      ModelStatus begin(SdCard card, String path)
      Loads the JLM1 file at path on card, which must already be mounted with its own SdCard.begin(), replacing any model loaded before. The file is copied into PSRAM through a 1 KiB buffer, so call it once, at startup. Returns ModelStatus.OK, ModelStatus.UNREADABLE for a missing or unreadable file, or why the engine refused it.

    • isLoaded

      boolean isLoaded()
      Whether a model is loaded.

    • width

      int width()
      The loaded model's embedding width, or 0.

    • layers

      int layers()
      The loaded model's number of transformer layers, or 0.

    • ask

      ModelStatus ask(String question, int creativity)
      Starts answering question, discarding any answer in progress. Creativity 0 picks the most likely character every time; up to MAX_CREATIVITY samples among the likely ones. Returns ModelStatus.OK, or why the question was not accepted.

    • ask

      ModelStatus ask(byte[] question, int length, int creativity)
      Like ask(String, int), for the first length bytes of question, such as a request body.

    • nextChar

      int nextChar()
      The answer's next character, or END when it is complete.

    • release

      void release()
      Frees the model's PSRAM; isLoaded() is false afterwards.
